name: Kommandantin Nochneun
personality: Can make a room feel ready by counting loudly enough.
visual_intent: Countdown Commander: broad low square ink splat,small teal peaked retro-space cap,two lashes,tiny cream collar,ONE handheld countdown paddle with THREE simple round indicator lights,no digits,and little brass whistle. Huge intense asymmetric open bellow with TWO upper teeth,one brow high
biography: Can make a room feel ready by counting loudly enough. Her HyperNorm lights announce readiness in three reliable colours. A dissonant card asks whether the quiet person at the back has finished checking. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bereitschaft wird durch hörbare Rückzählung unterstützt.

name: Knopfwart Gleichgleich
personality: Would like a moment to confirm what everybody means by now.
visual_intent: Launch Button Presser: tall narrow hooked ink blob,little rust technician cap,ONE compact brass launch box with large red button and hinged CLEAR protective cover OPEN away from eyes. One huge eye one anxious squint,closed nervous toothless zigzag lips,one goo finger hovering over button
biography: Would like a moment to confirm what everybody means by now. His HyperNorm button marks the boundary between waiting and the official irreversible moment. A dissonant card asks what now means to everybody else. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Zeitpunkt ist eindeutig, sobald er abgestimmt wurde.

name: Logbuchfrau Nachgetragen
personality: Records the decisive moment after it has acquired an approved wording.
visual_intent: Mission Log Clerk: round top-heavy ink blob,small cream visor ABOVE eyes,two subtle lashes,tiny plum collar,ONE thick logbook with THREE colored page tabs and short pencil. Heavy unequal tired lids,closed enormous toothless pout
biography: Records the decisive moment after it has acquired an approved wording. Her HyperNorm logbook converts messy events into approved sequence. A dissonant card asks her to preserve the hesitation between two entries. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der entscheidende Augenblick wurde nachträglich sprachlich freigegeben.

name: Schüsselhörer Ferngenau
personality: Can hear everything except the part everyone claims was obvious.
visual_intent: Satellite Dish Listener: squat broad asymmetric splat,little copper headset ABOVE exposed eyes,ONE tiny parabolic dish on short HANDLE with cable to small earpiece,no huge satellite/scenery. Huge unequal eyes turned sideways,small toothless open oval mouth
biography: Can hear everything except the part everyone claims was obvious. His dish catches HyperNorm signals classified as either instruction or interference. A dissonant card sounds inconveniently like a neighbour needing an explanation. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Empfang ist vollständig. Das Selbstverständliche fehlt.

name: Treibstoffwart Brennruhig
personality: Keeps the volatile part better contained than the briefing.
visual_intent: Rocket Fuel Mechanic: tall broad-based pear ink blob,small dark work cap,goggles ABOVE eyes,tiny canvas bib patch,ONE short chunky spanner and sealed amber fuel sample canister with plain flame pictogram,no fire/explosion. Gleeful crooked open smile with THREE upper teeth,one eye nearly winking
biography: Keeps the volatile part better contained than the briefing. His sealed HyperNorm canister receives more careful handling than the expectations around it. A dissonant card suggests testing the briefing for leaks too. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Flüchtige wurde besser als die Erwartungen gesichert.

name: Houston Rückfrage
personality: Has already called it a problem and is waiting for the approved synonym.
visual_intent: Houston Problem Caller: broad lopsided ink splat,small plum retro flight cap and tiny cream scarf,ONE large old telephone handset connected to SMALL radio box by short coiled cable. Hooded skeptical unequal lids,closed toothless crooked side-mouth,unimpressed resignation
biography: Has already called it a problem and is waiting for the approved synonym. His handset reports a HyperNorm problem before the naming committee approves one. A dissonant card stays on the line without demanding reassurance. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Störung wartet auf eine betriebsverträglichere Bezeichnung.
